objective: Prove by deterministic metamorphic tests that labels cannot affect record sampling, numeric-threshold compilation, conditioned response paths, oversized-cell sampling, or selected structural states.

protocol.record_sampling: feature-only SHA-256 rank with original row index tie-break
protocol.oversized_cell_sampling: SHA-256(task name, salt, sampled row index, compiled response row), labels excluded
protocol.state_selector: v0.60 conditioned-cell selector with only sample_allowed replaced

claim_boundary: Methodological label-independence certificate on synthetic tasks only. A pass is not algorithmic performance evidence, fresh external validation, independent outside-human reproduction, publication novelty, peer review, acceptance, or a world-level claim.
